title: Plugins
intro: Home Assistant and camera integrations are optional plugins. Manage installed plugins and their settings here.
immediate: Plugin actions do not require the main Save button. Use Save settings to apply plugin settings.
numericInvalid: Enter a value from {min} to {max} in steps of {step}{unit}.
numericChanged: The available settings have changed. Review the latest settings before applying a value.
noPublishers: Local signed-file installation has no approved publishers in this build. Configured archive downloads remain available.
permissionHelp: These declarations describe the plugin’s features. Plugins run with your user account’s access.
permissionVideo: Camera clips, snapshots, and live previews
confirmRemove: Uninstall {plugin} version {version}? Its worker will stop and its installed package files will be removed.
confirmRemoveConfigured: Uninstall {plugin} version {version}? Its worker will stop, its installed package files and saved declaration will be removed, and automatic restoration will stop.
operationFailed: Unable to complete the plugin operation.
notReady: Plugin management is not ready. Refresh to try again.
pickAgain: Select the package again to review it before another installation attempt.
settingsHelp: Saving restarts enabled plugins and retries plugins enabled by the application configuration.
settingsRestartFailed: Settings were saved, but the plugin could not restart.
settingsFailed: Unable to read or save plugin settings. Reload the settings and try again.
noSettings: This plugin has no editable settings.
secretHelp: Leave blank to keep the stored value. Saved secrets are never shown.
removeSecret: Remove the stored secret when saving
deleteSettings: Also delete this plugin’s settings and secrets
retainSettings: Settings and secrets are kept for a later installation unless you choose to delete them.
storedDataHelp: Manage saved settings and secrets without opening their contents. Unidentified records cannot be matched to a removed plugin.
storedDataUsage: {used} of {limit} bytes used; up to {records} records.
storedDataPending: Storage usage also includes pending writes.
installedDataProtected: An installed plugin uses this data. Uninstall the plugin before deleting its data.
confirmDeleteData: Permanently delete stored data record {record} ({bytes} bytes)? Its settings and secrets cannot be recovered.
configuredHelp: These packages are restored automatically from the saved application configuration.
configurationManaged: This plugin has a version pinned in configuration. Enable, disable, and uninstall changes are saved immediately; rollback is unavailable while the version is pinned.
invalidStructuredSetting: This saved value cannot be edited with the installed settings schema. It has been preserved.
choicesUnavailable: Choices are unavailable. You can still enter exact values.
